editorial:
Imagine moving into a creepy old house where every single mirror is covered up with sheets or hidden away. That is exactly what happens to these two sisters when they visit their aunt. The vibe is spooky from the start, and you can feel the tension as they try to figure out why their aunt is so scared of her own reflection. It feels like one of those classic scary stories where you know something bad is going to happen, but you can't stop watching to see when it finally hits.

The acting is solid and the jump scares actually work, though some parts of the story move a bit slow. If you love movies about demons and cursed objects, you will really dig this one. It is a great pick for a Friday night movie marathon with friends. To get the best experience, you should try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for those crisp, scary visuals. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go so you can watch it whenever you want.
endingExplained: At the end, the demon tries to take over the sisters' lives by using the mirrors. The twist is that the demon needs a physical body to stay in our world. After a scary battle, the sisters realize they have to break the connection to the mirror world. They manage to trap the evil spirit back where it belongs, but it leaves them shaken. The movie ends with a hint that the evil might not be fully gone.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves supernatural thrills and creepy houses.
